name: AILabel
purpose: Marks AI-generated content; explainability popover; "Revert to AI" after edits.
description: Marks AI-generated content and is the entry point to explainability: a pill with the gradient AI mark and a short word ("AI", "AI generated"). With an explanation it becomes a button that opens a popover: why the person sees this, which model made it, and — once they edited the content — "Revert to AI". Part of the Agent kit.

label.notes: Figma: Label — the visible word. Keep it short: "AI", "AI generated", "Draft by AI".

variant.notes: Figma: Style. `chip` (default) — tinted pill with the gradient mark. `inline` — mark and text, no fill; for message headers and table cells. `icon` — the mark only; the label stays available to screen readers.

explanation.notes: Figma: Explainability popover. Short, plain-language answer to "why am I seeing this?". When set, the label becomes a button that opens the popover.

explanationTitle.notes: Figma: Popover title — defaults to "About this AI content".

model.notes: Model or agent that produced the content, shown in the popover footer.

edited.notes: Figma: Edited — the person changed the AI content; the label reads "Edited" and loses the AI fill.

onRevert.notes: Figma: Revert to AI — shows a "Revert to AI" action in the popover (only while `edited`).

align.notes: Which edge of the label the popover lines up with; use `end` near the right edge of a layout

defaultOpen.notes: Start with the popover open (docs and tests)

do: Label every piece of AI-generated content in the same way across the product.
Say in the explanation where the content came from and what to check.
Offer "Revert to AI" whenever people can edit generated content.
forbidden: Never use `--gradient-ai`, `bg-ai-subtle` or `border-ai` on content that is not AI.
Never hide the label once the person has edited the content — switch it to Edited.
Never put actions other than Revert to AI and links to settings in the popover.
